title: Business English Conversation 34:  Employee Reviews
content: 1. employee reviews: evaluations that tell employees if they are doing a good job or not - We get employee reviews at the end of every year. - If you get a good employee review, then you will also probably get a raise. 2. You'd better...: a grammar point used to give advice (stronger than "You should") - You'd better work harder if you don't want to get fired. - You'd better leave earlier in the morning, so you aren't late to work again.
